releaseNotes: NeoPhoto early Windows x64 preview: native Rust editor and shared-engine CLI, no required account. Painting/erasing, rectangle selection, layers, undo/redo, whole-layer adjustments, project saving and PNG/JPEG export. Unsupported project data is retained; export is blocked for unsupported rendering features. Full legacy parity, PSD, colour-managed editing, high bit depth and advanced tools remain unfinished. Install separately using launcher Settings > Preview > Check app versions.
